body:
I hope to see you this summer/fall! (Only open-to-the-public events are listed.)

 August:

 11-12: VA: I’ll participate in a clergy protest against white supremacy in Charlottesville, VA

 18-19 – NY, Manhattan: Being Church in the Trump Years  – If you’re near NYC, I hope you’ll join us!

 September:

 10: PA, Salford Mennonite Church: 300th Anniversary Celebration

 16-17: MO, Kansas City, Second Presbyterian Church

 23-25: NC,  Davidson College

 October 

 1-2: GA, Mercer College. Preaching Consultation.

 13-14: CA, Redondo Beach, The Seventh Story Experience  – discovering the stories we live by as individuals, groups, and societies.

 27-28: IL, Chicago, Convergence Leadership Conference – ALIGNMENT   – building alignment in your congregation (for clergy, worship leaders, Christian educators, and lay leaders)

 November

 9-10, CA, Laverne: Church of the Brethren Conference

 16-18, FL, Deland: First UMC

 In between, I’ll be leading the Convergence Leadership Project with Jacqui Lewis. Info here . (It’s not too late to apply!)
